Features an LED monitor and a Manual/Auto toggle switch.

Promotional text 'Buy 1 Car Battery Charger & Get 2 Free' is overlaid on the image.

risks.risk: The device may not power on or output the correct charging voltage.

Video showing the device powered on and charging a battery.
Clarification on the 'Buy 1 Get 2 Free' offer.
response.reason: The seller has provided a stock image instead of a photo of the actual item. The 'Buy 1 Get 2 Free' offer is highly suspicious and typical of fraudulent listings. Real photos and proof of operation are mandatory.
